address: Avenida João Carlos da Silva Borges 764, São Paulo, 04726-001, Brazil
bio: This extraordinary partnership is the result of a bond of friendship, the fruits of which are clearly visible in this superb gastronomic restaurant. Located somewhat off the beaten track in the southern section of São Paulo, it occupies a property built in the 1960s. It features a charming and elegant space with various dining rooms, a stunning bar and an outdoor terrace when the weather allows (a section of the glass-fronted kitchen is also visible to guests). The menu showcases an Italian influence with fresh homemade pastas, generous portions and moderate prices. An “executive” menu is also available during the week. Standout dishes here include the authentic and extremely delicious spaghetti alla carbonara, and the classic tiramisu, with its perfect creamy texture....
